newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain sanctions seventh rate cut of year.
newsitem.headline: Spain sanctions seventh rate cut of year.

text.p: The Bank of Spain, cheered by tame inflation, sanctioned its seventh interest rate cut of the year Friday in a move that economists say paves the way for further hefty cuts well into next year.
The central bank cut its key money rate half a percentage point to 6.25 percent from 6.75 percent at its regular repurchase tender for central bank certificates.
Economists said November's inflation data, released minutes before the central bank announced the results of its tender, would have reassured the central bank that inflation was on a downward trend.
November Consumer Price Index data was unchanged after a 0.1 percent rise in October. Year-on-year inflation rose 3.2 percent, compared with 3.5 percent in October and 4.4 percent a year ago.
